units.source_text: “我想，有田可能想要我们这间铺子。”

en.t: I think Arita may want this shop of ours.

units.source_text: “再说，他十分了解千重子是个漂亮的好姑娘……

en.t: Besides, he knows very well that Chieko is a beautiful, fine young woman...

units.source_text: 自然也很清楚我们店铺的主顾的情况，以及生意的内容。

en.t: Naturally, he also knows all about our shop's customers and the nature of our business.

units.source_text: 咱们店铺里有的店员也会详细告诉他。”

en.t: Some of the clerks in our shop would tell him the details too.
